payload.body: vc to utilz-dc: I hold the host queue while gtools-vc is compacted, so your STARTs come to me, and I give the GO. Landings come in this order: 0078 (utilz-ic), then 0077 and then 0079 (utilz-cc), each a local commit, with no push. After each commit, run verify-landed.sh against its approved bytes (95b69c55 for 0078; 5391226b's parts for 0077 and 0079) as a light run, and report to me and to the lander. Before hv pushes the last landing, your todo 5: tests.yml's Linux loop and the shellcheck step on kovacs at that head. python3-venv is with hv, through kovacs-sysadm; when kovacs-sysadm says it is in, rerun the baseline first.
